name: Pacific Northwest Continuity Exercise
description: Protect port, rail, air, warehouse, and digital logistics connections across a fictional coastal and inland network.
commandIntent: Maintain essential movement while adapting to weather, capacity limits, infrastructure failures, and trusted-information problems.

assets.name: MV Cascade
assets.route: Coastal approach → Port Horizon → inland transfer
assets.alternateRoute: Coastal holding area → secondary terminal → inland transfer
assets.cargo: Packaged food, medical supplies, and containerized goods
assets.meaning: A cargo vessel moves large quantities of goods between ports.

assets.name: SkyLift 27
assets.alternateRoute: Skybridge airspace → eastern diversion → Northstar Logistics Hub
assets.cargo: Urgent medicine, electronics, and time-sensitive parts
assets.meaning: Air cargo moves urgent or high-value goods quickly between hubs.

assets.name: PNW Freight 6
assets.route: Riverbend Rail Junction → Cedar Distribution Center
assets.alternateRoute: Riverbend bypass → western interchange → Cedar Distribution Center
assets.cargo: Grain, fuel, building materials, and industrial equipment
assets.meaning: A freight train moves heavy cargo efficiently across long inland routes.

assets.name: RoadLink 14
assets.route: Cedar Distribution Center → Northstar Logistics Hub → Skybridge Airport
assets.alternateRoute: Cedar Distribution Center → Riverbend bypass → Skybridge Airport
assets.cargo: Groceries, hospital supplies, and priority replacement parts
assets.meaning: A truck handles flexible last-mile and alternate-route deliveries.

approaching.title: Pacific windstorm approaching
approaching.summary: A fast-moving frontal system is approaching the regional network from the coast.

assetEffects.reason: Increasing coastal winds are slowing the vessel's approach.
The aircraft is operating with additional wind checks and spacing.

warning.title: High-wind warning active
warning.summary: Unsafe winds have stopped exposed cargo handling and reduced transportation capacity.
warning.affectedArea: Port, airport, rail approaches, and highways

assetEffects.reason: High winds have stopped exposed port and vessel operations.
Crosswinds exceed the exercise safety threshold for cargo operations.
Wind inspections and debris checks are reducing rail speed.
High-profile vehicles are moving at reduced speed in strong winds.

clearing.title: Storm clearing east of the network
clearing.summary: Winds are decreasing, but inspections and cargo backlogs continue to affect movement.

assetEffects.reason: The vessel is using a protected approach while the main terminal is inspected.
The aircraft is using an alternate arrival path during recovery inspections.

operatingConditions.title: Normal regional demand
operatingConditions.summary: The network begins with normal demand and planned backup capacity available.

operatingConditions.title: Peak-season congestion
operatingConditions.summary: Warehouses and transportation routes are already operating near capacity.

operatingConditions.title: Mutual-aid teams staged
operatingConditions.summary: Partner organizations have shared limited staff and transportation capacity before the first inject.

operatingConditions.title: Communications capacity strained
operatingConditions.summary: Partners are receiving delayed updates, increasing the cost of an uncoordinated response.
